caption: The drawing features a central depiction of a lidded tankard with a large, ornate handle that curves outward and downward, ending in a decorative scroll. The tankard is rendered in grayscale pencil with shading to suggest volume and form, and has a circular lid with a small knob, along with a thumb lever for opening the lid. The body of the tankard is cylindrical with straight sides and a slightly wider base. Around the central tankard, there are four smaller technical drawings in each corner. The top left corner shows a detailed side view of a hinge labeled "RF. HOLE." The top right corner contains a profile view of the lid’s edge labeled "TOP OF COVER." The bottom left corner displays a spherical knob labeled "KNOB PLAN." The bottom right corner depicts a simplified side profile of the tankard with annotated dimensions. The entire composition is set on an off-white background, with faint lines forming a border around the central tankard and connecting to the four corner details. All elements are drawn with fine, precise lines, and the shading on the central object is more pronounced than on the corner diagrams.
title: Pewter Tankard
